manifest.name: dsh-550c-boot
manifest.description: 550C 开机动画 + 登录授权界面：启动时播放 550C 片头，之后可走一段可交互的访问授权（UEG 联合政府 / 550C 控制终端两套主题），点击或 Enter 推进、Esc 跳过；通用设置里可切换或关闭。

contributors.name: Voidpocket
contributors.comment: 550C 片头动画与 HTML 源码（assets/550C-source.html）

suite.title: 550C
suite.note: 同一套件的两个插件，可各自独立安装。同时安装时「550C」设置页由本插件提供，皮肤插件只往里加自己的设置行；两者没有任何代码依赖。

capability.invocation: Boot the profile's Web GUI, then read the first frame from the page: document.querySelector('.dsh550c-host') and its shadowRoot's #boot stage, plus document.documentElement.classList.contains('dsh550c-first') on the way in.
capability.expected: The host half's first frame covers the shell while the document is still parsing, so DSH's [data-dsh-boot] card is never visible; the client splash then mounts the ported #boot stage in a shadow root on the same task that retires that cover, and plays to completion.

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run check && npm test && npm run test:harness
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/extract.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/index.js

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch for dsh-550c-boot.
#
# This is what makes the package a PROFILE LAYER rather than an inert
# dependency: the row below mounts the plugin, and the package's `dsh.client`
# block (package.json) is what gets the browser half served and loaded.
#
# A package that declares only `dsh.client` is not installable — the plugin
# market's own submission gate rejects it with "declares only dsh.client —
# that alone is not installable". Both blocks are required.
- insert:
    - id: boot-550c
      name: dsh-550c-boot

**给 DeepSeek Harness 加一段 550C 开机片头，接一段能点着玩的 UEG 访问授权。**

打开 DSH 先看片头。片头之后，你是一名为联合政府工作的操作员 —— 终端在跑、身份卡在核验、地球在转。点击或按 `Enter` 往下走，`Esc` 随时跳过。

0.5.0 起，身份卡上的二维码和片头音乐都可以换成你自己的。

---

- **两个档位**：简易档约 4 秒（logo 书写）／ 完整档约 17 秒（覆写全流程），也可以一键关掉
- **随时跳过**：点一下画面，或按 `Esc`
- **不露馅**：首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段就盖上去，DSH 自己的 `HARNESS / Loading plugins…` 卡片不会再闪出来
- **桌面端也照顾到**：片头播放时，窗口右上角那三个系统按钮会跟着变透明，符号色跟着主题走
- **开机音乐**：导入自己的音频，试听、改名、删除、指定曲目。音量和淡出时长（0.5–4 秒）都能调；
  淡出按片头时长提前排程，收在画面结束后约半秒，不会硬切。
  只在 550C 片头播放，曲库存在本机（上限 3.6 MB），所以建议剪 19 秒左右的片段再导入

片头之后可以接着走一段**可交互**的访问授权，一共三幕：

1. **过曝洗白 → 底板擦出** —— 终端、身份卡、地球依次到位
2. **五步授权** —— 身份核验、权限判定、许可证签发，一路打字机 + 语音播报
3. **色散揭幕** —— 终幕把整屏收成一句话

- 点击或按 `Enter` 推进，`Esc` 跳过
- **两套主题**：UEG 联合政府（浅色公文风）／ 550C 控制终端（暗色终端风）
- **可以 DIY 你的身份卡**：操作员姓名、头像、编号、授权等级、签发机构、有效期、许可范围、生物特征
- **二维码也能换成你自己的**：填一段文字或链接，本机编码成二维码；也可以选一张现成的二维码图片，本机识别出内容后按卡片风格重绘。全程不联网
- **结论落定的那一拍**：核验完成时整卡刷过一条读取光带，底部浮出「▸ 核验通过 · ACCESS GRANTED」，文字先乱码再逐字定格，底部竖条随之收平
- **配音**：男声已就绪；女声仍在制作中（界面标着「开发中」）
- **自动播放**：默认开启，也可以改成手动

设置里多一个 **550C** 页，顶部是胶囊切换条：

| 分组 | 里面放什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **外观** | 皮肤相关的设置行 |
| **550C 开机动画** | 片头档位、配色、开机音乐（导入 / 试听 / 音量 / 淡出）、版本与更新 |
| **UEG 登录界面** | 界面档位、自动播放、配音、卡面 DIY、身份卡二维码、预览 |

- **检查更新**：直接读 npm 上的最新版本，告诉你有没有新版，支持一键更新（桌面端会让你去「设置 → 插件」里装）
- **预览**：不用重启，点一下就能看动画

想要整套视觉一致，配一个同套件的皮肤插件：

> **[dsh-550c-skin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-550c-skin)** —— 把 DSH 整个界面换成 550C 控制台（四套磷光配色、扫描线、等宽字体、机器读数栏）。

两个插件**各自独立安装、互不依赖**；同时装上时，550C 设置页由本插件提供，皮肤只往里加自己的设置行。

readme.section: 也可以试试这两个启动动画插件
readme.text:
如果你正在挑启动动画，这两个项目也值得看一眼：

- **[dsh-startup-secret](https://github.com/huzhengcai471-crypto/dsh-startup-secret)** —— by [@huzhengcai471-crypto](https://github.com/huzhengcai471-crypto)
- **[dsh-startup-screen](https://github.com/6shenhonghong9/dsh-startup-screen)** —— by [@6shenhonghong9](https://github.com/6shenhonghong9)

三个插件各自独立，装哪个都不影响另外两个。如果它们对你的口味，去给两位作者点个 ⭐ 就是最好的鼓励。

---

```bash
npm i dsh-550c-boot
```

或者直接在 DSH 里：**设置 → 插件 → 安装** `dsh-550c-boot@latest`。装完重启一次客户端。

---

```
设置 → 550C
  ├─ 550C 开机动画   选档位（简易 / 完整 / 关闭）、换配色
  └─ UEG 登录界面    选界面、开自动播放、选配音、改身份卡、点「预览」看效果
```

> 片头和 UEG 界面**只能留一个**：UEG 自带完整三幕，所以它开着的时候片头会自动让位。关掉其中一个就能用另一个。

---

- **女声配音**还在做（界面上标着「开发中」）
- **桌面端不能自动更新**（desktop profile 由客户端独占管理）—— 点「检查更新」会告诉你去「设置 → 插件」里装
- 片头和 UEG 界面互斥，不能同时开
- **开机音乐只存在本机**（曲库上限 3.6 MB，再高会撞浏览器存储配额），不随插件同步，换设备要重新导入
- **音乐要比片头长 2 秒以上**（完整档约 17 秒），否则会先播完、听不到淡出
- **二维码内容建议控制在 80 字节以内**，太长模块会变密、手机不好扫
- **UEG 登录界面开启时不播开机音乐** —— 那里自带配音，避免两个声音打架

**A 550C boot intro for DeepSeek Harness, followed by a UEG access-permission sequence you can actually click through.**

Open DSH and the intro plays first. After it, you are an operator working for the United Earth Government - terminals running, your ID being verified, the globe turning. Click or press `Enter` to move on, `Esc` to skip.

---

- **Two modes**: simple (~4s, logo drawn in) / full (~16s, the whole overwrite sequence) - or turn it off entirely
- **Skip anytime**: click anywhere, or press `Esc`
- **No flash of the stock loader**: the host half paints the first frame while the document is still parsing, so DSH's own `HARNESS / Loading plugins...` card never shows
- **Desktop-friendly**: while the intro plays, the three caption buttons in the window corner go transparent and take the theme's accent colour

A three-act, interactive sequence that can follow the intro:

1. **Blown-out wash, then the board wipes in** - terminal, ID card and globe arrive in order
2. **Five verification steps** - identity check, clearance, permit issued - typed out with voice-over
3. **Chromatic reveal** - the finale collapses the screen into a single line

- Click or press `Enter` to advance, `Esc` to skip
- **Two themes**: UEG (light, official paperwork) / 550C control terminal (dark)
- **Make the ID card yours**: operator name, photo, serial, clearance level, issuer, validity, scope, biometrics
- **Voice-over**: male is ready (one audio file per line - it never rushes or clips the last word); female is still in progress and marked "开发中" in the UI
- **Autoplay**: on by default, can be switched to manual

A new **550C** page in Settings, with a pill-style switcher on top:

| Group | What is in it |
| --- | --- |
| **外观 / Look** | skin-related rows |
| **550C 开机动画 / Boot** | intro mode, colour scheme, version and update |
| **UEG 登录界面 / Login** | screen mode, autoplay, voice, ID card, preview |

- **Check for updates**: reads the latest version from npm and offers a one-click update (on the desktop client it points you to Settings → Plugins instead)
- **Preview**: play the animation without restarting

For a matching look, pair it with the skin from the same suite:

> **[dsh-550c-skin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-550c-skin)** - repaints the whole DSH shell as a 550C console (four phosphor schemes, scan line, monospace, readout rails).

The two plugins **install independently and have no code dependency**; when both are present, this plugin owns the 550C settings page and the skin only adds its own rows to it.

---

```bash
npm i dsh-550c-boot
```

Or inside DSH: **Settings → Plugins → install** `dsh-550c-boot@latest`, then restart the client.

---

```
Settings → 550C
  ├─ 550C 开机动画   pick a mode (simple / full / off), change the colour scheme
  └─ UEG 登录界面    pick the screen, autoplay, voice, edit the ID card, hit Preview
```

> The intro and the UEG sequence are **mutually exclusive**: UEG brings its own three acts, so the intro steps aside while it is on. Turn one off to use the other.

---

- **Female voice-over** is still in progress (marked in the UI)
- **No self-update on the desktop client** (the desktop profile is managed exclusively by the app) - the update check points you to Settings → Plugins
- Intro and UEG sequence cannot both be on
